originalPreservation.note: Read-only review of external collision/shadow merge #12 across 16 committed paths, plus two new external presence-badge edits in previously clean visual source/documentation. Pre-existing World and roster edits verified by reversing unique committed hunks in memory and recovering both prior whole-file hashes. Other unfinished and untracked work preserved. performanceDecision: Keep the measured idle/ongoing fast paths. Ongoing ordinary updates are 39.0–45.3% lower than v0.29 in two controlled desktop runs. Complete cycles are 1.4–1.5% higher than the first candidate and reverse direction against v0.29; no overall speedup is established.
verifierScope: Full optimized SDK verifier and installed faults use the same final runtime bytes. Final documentation archive and exact-commit hosted checks follow separately.
developmentCorrections: Preserve native primary-player hold versus seated-actor finesse and aim predicates.
Preserve lazy mode-service binding and active-state clearing before delivery.
Limit overlay negative controls to the parsed method; omitted-call mutation uses a valid statement and must reach behavior before receiving credit.
Retain initial candidate as an independent benchmark control; original accepted fixtures remain unchanged.
limits: Eleven of thirteen families remain partial. Actual spatial/effect mechanics, broader World scheduling, native full-runtime engine packages and Steam Deck/older-mobile acceptance remain incomplete. No allocation-volume or whole-game performance claim.
